records.source: 952 (item 1006): ``ops_flatfield`` was ``'none'``; it is now ``'exact'``, so an OPS phenotype run divides every pixel by the plate's flat-field maps before measuring and needs them (phases ``ph_flatfield`` and ``ph_flatfield_objects``, or a prebuilt ``ops_flatfield_maps`` folder). ``ops_flatfield_channel_fit`` was the earlier maps, ``'legacy'`` (the polynomial DNA map and pixel-median maps of the other channels); it is now the object median of every channel, nuclear for DNA and ``ops_flatfield_nuclear_stains``, cytoplasmic for the others. 949-951 belong to other items.
